design_detail: Progressive annual wealth tax of 2% to 10% on net assets above 40m TL to fund a guaranteed basic income fund
quote_original: 1.- Mersin Milletvekili Perihan Koca'nın; Servet Vergisi ve Temel Gelir Güvencesi Kanun Teklifi (2/2613) (Sağlık, Aile, Çalışma ve Sosyal İşler ile Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonlarına) (Başkanlığa geliş tarihi:16.10.2024)
quote_en: 1.- Mersin MP Perihan Koca's Bill on Wealth Tax and Basic Income Guarantee (2/2613) (Referred to Health, Family, Labour and Social Affairs and Plan and Budget Commissions) (Arrival date to Speaker: 16.10.2024)
source_title: TBMM Gelen Kağıtlar No: 13, 17 Ekim 2024
grading_note: A-grade: Sponsored bill 2/2613 in TBMM introducing progressive wealth tax on net assets from 40m TL.

design_detail: Comprehensive valuation of all asset classes and progressive taxation on accumulated wealth with primary residence exemption
quote_original: Bütün gelir ve servet unsurlarını kayda alalım, bütün konutlar değerlensin, kaç para değerinde olduğu belirlensin, servetler de artan oranlı olarak vergilendirilsin; 1 kişinin 1 evi varsa vergi dışı olsun, mütevazı bir evi varsa vergi dışı bırakalım ama bin tane evi varsa artan oranlı olarak vergilendirelim dedik.
quote_en: Let's record all income and wealth components, let all residences be valued, let their value be determined, and let wealth be taxed progressively; if one person has one house let it be exempt, but if someone has a thousand houses let it be taxed progressively.
source_title: TBMM Genel Kurul Tutanağı 27. Dönem 3. Yasama Yılı 17. Birleşim
grading_note: A-grade: Plenary parliamentary address explicitly proposing progressive net wealth taxation across all wealth components.

design_detail: Official progressive wealth tax in party economic platform to replace indirect consumption taxes
quote_original: Zenginlere zenginliklerine paralel olarak artan oranda bir biçimde servet vergisi uygulayacağız. Bununla birlikte temel zaruri mallardaki KDV ve ÖTV’yi sıfırlayacağız. Gelir vergisi oranları en zenginleri daha fazla vergilendirecek şekilde dik ve artan oranlı olarak yeniden düzenlenecek.
quote_en: We will implement a wealth tax on the rich in progressive rates in parallel with their wealth. In addition, we will zero VAT and SCT on essential goods. Income tax rates will be restructured steeply and progressively to tax the richest more.
source_title: Demokratik Ekonomi Programımızı açıkladık
grading_note: A-grade: Official party economic programme adopting progressive net wealth taxation.

design_detail: Congress framework document demanding wealth taxation against impoverishment of labour
quote_original: Partimiz emeğin yoksullaştırılmasına karşı servet vergisi, emekçilerin barınma hakkının elinden alınmasına karşı, barınma rantına neden olan konutların kamulaştırılması, çalışma saatlerinin düşürülmesi vb. birçok talebini daha belirgin hale getirecek ve gündeme taşıyacaktır.
quote_en: Our party will make prominent and bring to the agenda its many demands: a wealth tax against the impoverishment of labour, nationalisation of housing generating property windfalls against deprivation of workers' housing rights, reduction of working hours, etc.
source_title: 2. Kongre Çerçeve Belgesi: Cumhuriyet’in 2. Yüzyılında Emekçiler Kazanacak!
grading_note: B-grade: Official national congress resolution document adopting wealth tax as a core campaign policy.

design_detail: Petition and campaign demand to introduce a wealth tax on corporate bosses
quote_original: Patronlara servet vergisi getirilsin!
quote_en: Introduce a wealth tax on bosses!
source_title: Emek Partisi Bursa İl Örgütü'nden ‘İnsanca yaşanacak ücret, vergide adalet istiyoruz’ kampanyası
grading_note: B-grade: Official party campaign platform calling for wealth taxation on owners of capital.

design_detail: Permanent progressive wealth tax on large fortunes as part of tax justice campaign
quote_original: DİSK’in talepleri arasında büyük servetlerin vergilendirileceği kalıcı ve artan oranlı servet vergisi, gelir vergisinin ilk dilim oranının yüzde 10’a düşürülmesi, ücretliler için daha adil ve kademeli bir vergi sistemi kurulması
quote_en: Among DİSK's demands are a permanent and progressive wealth tax to tax large fortunes, reducing the first bracket rate of income tax to 10 percent, and establishing a fairer and tiered tax system for wage earners
source_title: DİSK’ten vergi dairesi önünde 'Ücret Kayıpları İzleme Raporu' eylemi
grading_note: A-grade: Official trade union confederation action and report demanding a permanent, progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: Public address by DİSK President demanding progressive wealth taxation on large fortunes
quote_original: DİSK’in talepleri arasında büyük servetlerin vergilendirileceği kalıcı ve artan oranlı servet vergisi, gelir vergisinin ilk dilim oranının yüzde 10’a düşürülmesi, ücretliler için daha adil ve kademeli bir vergi sistemi kurulması
quote_en: Among DİSK's demands are a permanent and progressive wealth tax to tax large fortunes, reducing the first bracket rate of income tax to 10 percent, and establishing a fairer and tiered tax system for wage earners
source_title: DİSK’ten vergi dairesi önünde 'Ücret Kayıpları İzleme Raporu' eylemi
grading_note: B-grade: Bianet reports Çerkezoğlu naming the progressive wealth tax among DİSK's demands at the 6 July 2024 action; it is the confederation's list of demands, not her own sentence. DİSK itself (E00006) is A.

design_detail: Trade union confederation demand for wealth tax on fortunes exceeding a given threshold
quote_original: kar, faiz ve servet gelirlerine tanınan ayrıcalıkların kaldırılmasını, asgari ücretin vergi dışı bırakılmasını, belli bir servet düzeyinin üzerindeki zenginlerden servet vergisi alınmasını
quote_en: abolishing privileges granted to profit, interest and wealth income, exempting minimum wage from taxation, and levying a wealth tax on the rich above a certain wealth level
source_title: Yılın Son KPDK Toplantısı Gerçekleştirildi
grading_note: A-grade: Confederation bargaining document demanding net wealth taxation above a wealth threshold.

design_detail: One-off wealth levy of 1% on all net assets exceeding 6m TL (first 6m TL exempt) payable over 24-36 months
quote_original: Bence bu dönemde “Servet Vergisi”ne ihtiyaç var. Varlığı 6 milyon liranın üzerinde olan herkesten yüzde 1 Servet Vergisi alınsın. Servet Vergisi kapsamına dahil olanların varlıklarının 6 milyon liralık kısmı da muafiyet kapsamına girsin.
quote_en: In my opinion there is a need for a 'Wealth Tax' in this period. Let a 1% Wealth Tax be levied on everyone whose assets exceed 6 million lira. Let the 6 million lira portion of the assets of those included in the Wealth Tax scope be exempt.
source_title: İbrahim Erdemoğlu: Yüzde 1 servet vergisi gelsin, 150 milyar dolar deprem kaynağı yaratılsın
grading_note: A-grade: Forbes billionaire industrialist explicitly proposing a 1% net wealth levy with specific exemption threshold.

design_detail: Emergency one-off wealth tax during crisis period to fund social assistance and public expenditure
quote_original: Bu katkılara salgın süresiyle sınırlı “olağan-dışı bir servet vergisi” seçeneği de eklenmeli... Toplam talep yetersizliği ekonomiyi, bugünkü gibi üretim potansiyelinin çok altına çekmişse, bu tür bir önlemler paketi enflasyonist değildir.
quote_en: To these contributions, the option of an 'extraordinary wealth tax' limited to the duration of the pandemic should also be added... If aggregate demand deficiency has pulled the economy well below its production potential, this type of measures package is not inflationary.
source_title: Korkut Boratav: Dünyayı sert bir finansal kriz ve toplumsal bunalım bekliyor
grading_note: A-grade: Senior economist endorsing an emergency wealth tax to finance crisis recovery.

design_detail: Emergency wealth levy on deposits and wealth above a threshold to fund post-earthquake recovery
quote_original: Bunun için servet vergisi getirilmeli. Belli bir mevduatın üstünde büyüklüğü olanlardan, serveti olanlardan binde bir gibi bir vergi zor mu? Başka mekanizmalar da olabilir.
quote_en: For this a wealth tax should be introduced. Is a tax like one per thousand on those with size above a certain deposit, those with wealth, difficult? There could also be other mechanisms.
source_title: Prof. Dr. Aziz Konukman, depremin bütçeye yükünün sermayeden karşılanmasını önerdi
grading_note: A-grade: Public finance economist proposing specific post-earthquake wealth tax.

design_detail: Annual progressive net wealth tax with progressive schedule starting from $1 million
quote_original: Ayrıca bu verginin tek seferlik değil, her yıl ve matrah arttıkça artan oranda, yani artan oranlı bir tarife ile alınması vergilemede adalet açısından daha uygundur.
quote_en: Furthermore, collecting this tax not as a one-off but each year and with an increasing rate as the tax base increases, that is with a progressive schedule, is more appropriate in terms of tax justice.
source_title: Erdemoğlu’nun önerdiği servet vergisi kimleri hedefliyor?
grading_note: A-grade: Public finance academic formulating a progressive annual net wealth tax design.

design_detail: Calls wealth tax the most effective and equitable taxation method to tackle wealth inequality
quote_original: Gezegenimizin toplam servetinin yüzde 85’inin en üst gelirli, yüzde 1 tarafından el konulduğu bir dünyada ve bunun Türkiye uzantılarında virüsün yıkıcı etkileriyle mücadelenin ana amacı eşitlik ilkesinin korunması ve yurttaşlık bilincine dayalı dayanışma olmalıdır” diyen Yeldan, “servet vergisi”nin bu bakımdan en etkin ve hakça vergilendirme yöntemi olarak görüldüğünü söyledi.
quote_en: Yeldan stated that in a world where 85 percent of our planet's total wealth is appropriated by the top 1 percent income group, the wealth tax is seen as the most effective and equitable method of taxation.
source_title: Prof. Erinç Yeldan: Eşitlik ve hakkaniyet için en etkin-hakça yöntem servet vergisi
grading_note: B-grade: Prominent academic economist endorsing wealth taxation by name.

design_detail: Broadcast interview advocating progressive wealth tax on the rich instead of indirect taxes
quote_original: Zenginlerden artan oranlarda 'servet vergisi' şart
quote_en: A progressive 'wealth tax' on the rich is imperative
source_title: İktisatçı Prof. Dr. Oğuz Oyan: Zenginlerden artan oranlarda 'servet vergisi' şart
grading_note: A-grade: Economist and former MP calling for progressive wealth tax on the wealthy.

design_detail: High-threshold net wealth tax on top fortunes based on Saez-Zucman model
quote_original: Bu durumda gelir adaletsizliğini gidermenin en önemli aracının servet vergisi olduğunu belirten Kozanoğlu, Fransız araştırmacılar Emmanuel Saez ve Gabriel Zuchman’ın bu uygulamaya ilişkin önerilerini şöyle sıraladı: "Birincisi, yüksek bir muafiyet eşiği tanımlanmalı.
quote_en: Stating that in this case the most important tool to eliminate income inequality is the wealth tax, Kozanoğlu listed the proposals of French researchers Emmanuel Saez and Gabriel Zucman regarding this implementation: 'First, a high exemption threshold should be defined.'
source_title: Zenginler de bedel ödesin: Servet vergisi
grading_note: A-grade: Columnist and finance professor endorsing net wealth tax with specific structural criteria.

design_detail: 5% net wealth tax on Turkey's 30 dollar billionaires to raise 153 billion TL for social investment and women's economic rights
quote_original: Türkiye’de 30 dolar milyarderine uygulanacak %5 oranında bir servet vergisi ile 153 milyar TL gelir yaratılabilir. Bu gelirle elde edilen kamu bütçesiyle toplumsal refahı artıracak adımlar atılabilir.
quote_en: With a 5% wealth tax applied to 30 dollar billionaires in Turkey, 153 billion TL of revenue can be created. Steps to increase social welfare can be taken with the public budget obtained from this revenue.
source_title: Oxfam 2026 Raporu Yayımlandı: “Servet İktidarı: Milyarderlerin Gücüne Karşı Eşitliği Savunma”
grading_note: B-grade: KEDV, Oxfam's Turkish partner, publishes Oxfam's 2026 calculation of a 5% wealth tax on Turkey's 30 billionaires on its own site; the rate is Oxfam's recommendation and KEDV does not restate it in its own words.

design_detail: Parliamentary address demanding wealth and rent tax on corporations and top fortunes
quote_original: Servet ve rant vergisi alın hadi. Yapabilir misiniz? Cevap istiyoruz!
quote_en: Go ahead and levy a wealth and rent tax. Can you do it? We want an answer!
source_title: Sevda Karaca'dan iktidara: Servet ve rant vergisi alın hadi, yapabilir misiniz?
grading_note: A-grade: Member of Parliament delivering speech in TBMM plenary demanding wealth tax.

design_detail: Official statement responding to Medium Term Program demanding wealth tax on large corporations and monopolies
quote_original: Büyük şirketlerden, tekellerden ayrıca servet vergisi alınmalı.
quote_en: A wealth tax must also be levied on large corporations and monopolies.
source_title: EMEP Genel Başkanı Aslan: OVP ücretleri bastırmanın, sömürüde istikrarın garantisidir
grading_note: A-grade: Party leader demanding wealth tax on big corporations and monopolies.

design_detail: Official trade union economic report demanding net wealth tax on top income groups and large wealth holders
quote_original: Üst gelir gruplarına ve büyük servet sahiplerine yönelik olarak servet vergisi uygulanmalıdır.
quote_en: A wealth tax should be implemented targeting upper income groups and large wealth holders.
source_title: Gelirde ve vergide adaletsizlik büyüyor
grading_note: A-grade: National trade union leadership report setting out fiscal demands including wealth tax.

design_detail: VII. Term public sector collective bargaining proposal demanding wealth tax on wealth holders above a certain threshold
quote_original: belli bir düzeyin üzerinde servet sahiplerine Servet Vergisi getirilmesini,
quote_en: the introduction of a Wealth Tax on holders of wealth above a certain level,
source_title: İnsanca Yaşam, Güvenceli İş, Güvenli Gelecek İçin VII. Dönem Toplu Sözleşme Teklifimiz
grading_note: A-grade: Public sector union collective bargaining demand document formally proposing a wealth tax.

design_detail: Article 5 of the 10-point emergency economic program Zenginlerin Değil Halkın Programı
quote_original: Servet vergisi uygulanacak
quote_en: A wealth tax will be implemented
source_title: İşsizliğe, Yoksulluğa, Pahalılığa Karşı Çözüm Programı.
grading_note: A-grade: Official party economic program formally adopting a wealth tax.

design_detail: Parliamentary address demanding progressive wealth tax in brackets on fortunes of 5 million dollars and above
quote_original: 5 milyon dolar ve üzerinde serveti olanlardan, vergi dilimlerine paralel olarak servet vergisi alın.
quote_en: Levy a wealth tax in parallel with tax brackets on those with a wealth of 5 million dollars and above.
source_title: EMEP’li Bayhan: Siz mali oligarşinin Şimşek’isiniz, işçileri çarpıyorsunuz!
grading_note: A-grade: Member of Parliament specifying wealth tax threshold ($5m) and progressive brackets in parliamentary budget speech.

design_detail: TBMM plenary address arguing public finances cannot recover without introducing a wealth tax
quote_original: Servet vergisi konulmadan Türkiye’de kamu maliyesi düzelmez, kamu maliyesinin düzelmesi için servet vergisi konulması lazım.
quote_en: Without introducing a wealth tax, public finances in Turkey will not recover; for public finances to recover, a wealth tax must be introduced.
source_title: TBMM Genel Kurul Tutanağı 28. Dönem 2. Yasama Yılı 107. Birleşim
grading_note: A-grade: Member of Parliament delivering speech on TBMM floor demanding wealth tax as essential for fiscal recovery.

design_detail: Article in Emek Gazetesi calling for progressive and permanent wealth tax on large fortunes
quote_original: Büyük servetlerden artan oranlı ve kalıcı bir servet vergisi alınmalı, ücretliler üzerindeki vergi yükü azaltılmalı ve damga vergisi kaldırılmalıdır.
quote_en: A progressive and permanent wealth tax must be levied on large fortunes, the tax burden on wage earners must be reduced, and stamp tax must be abolished.
source_title: Genel Başkanımız Remzi Çalışkan, Emek Gazetesinin 192. Sayısı için Yazdı: Emeğin Hakları, Gelirde Adalet ve Demokrasi Mücadelesi
grading_note: A-grade: Union leader calling for progressive and permanent wealth tax in official trade union newspaper.

design_detail: Joint emergency economic declaration with DİSK, KESK, TTB and TDB demanding progressive wealth tax
quote_original: artan oranlı servet vergisinin uygulandığı bir vergi düzeni getirilmelidir.
quote_en: a tax regime in which a progressive wealth tax is implemented must be introduced.
source_title: DİSK, KESK, TMMOB, TTB, TDB : GEÇİNEMİYORUZ ZAMLAR GERİ ALINSIN
grading_note: A-grade: Official joint declaration of statutory professional chambers and trade unions demanding progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: National health budget evaluation report urging implementation of a wealth tax to fund public healthcare
quote_original: Özellikle önümüzdeki yıllar için servet vergisi uygulaması düşünülmelidir.
quote_en: Especially for the coming years, the implementation of a wealth tax should be considered.
source_title: TTB 2021 yılı Sağlık Bütçesi ile ilgili görüşlerini açıkladı
grading_note: A-grade: National professional association budget policy document formally advocating wealth tax implementation.

design_detail: TBMM plenary address criticizing tax package for omitting a wealth tax on top earners
quote_original: Ne çok kazanan vergilendirildi ne de servet vergisi getirildi.
quote_en: Neither were high earners taxed, nor was a wealth tax introduced.
source_title: TBMM Tutanak Dergisi 28. Dönem 2. Yasama Yılı 111. Birleşim
grading_note: B-grade: group speech for DEM Parti. The sentence regrets that no wealth tax came with the tax package, so support is implied, not a stated demand.

design_detail: Genel-İş publishes its General President's article calling for a progressive and permanent wealth tax on large fortunes
quote_original: Büyük servetlerden artan oranlı ve kalıcı bir servet vergisi alınmalı, ücretliler üzerindeki vergi yükü azaltılmalı ve damga vergisi kaldırılmalıdır.
quote_en: A progressive and permanent wealth tax must be levied on large fortunes, the tax burden on wage earners must be reduced, and stamp tax must be abolished.
source_title: Genel Başkanımız Remzi Çalışkan, Emek Gazetesinin 192. Sayısı için Yazdı: Emeğin Hakları, Gelirde Adalet ve Demokrasi Mücadelesi
grading_note: B-grade: the earlier quote (a 2026 Genel-İş report) only listed wealth tax among direct taxes and did not call for one. Re-sourced to the General President's op-ed, published on the union's own site, so the union is graded B and the president A0024 A.

design_detail: Peer-reviewed academic paper proposing an annual progressive net wealth tax for Turkey
quote_original: Bu noktadan hareketle hazırlanan bu çalışmanın amacı, örnek ülke uygulamalarından yola çıkarak Türkiye için yeni bir net servet vergisi önerisi ortaya koymaktır.
quote_en: From this starting point, the purpose of this study is to put forward a new net wealth tax proposal for Turkey based on exemplary country practices.
source_title: SERVET DAĞILIMINDA SERVET VERGİSİNİN ROLÜ: TÜRKİYE İÇİN BİR NET SERVET VERGİSİ ÖNERİSİ
publisher: International Journal of Management Economics and Business
grading_note: A-grade: Academic public finance paper setting out an explicit annual net wealth tax design for Turkey.

design_detail: Peer-reviewed public finance study demonstrating efficacy of broad-based net wealth taxation for inequality reduction
quote_original: Bu şekilde geniş tabanlı bir servet vergisi eşitsizliğin giderilmesinde ve adil vergilemede etkili olacaktır.
quote_en: In this way, a broad-based wealth tax will be effective in eliminating inequality and in fair taxation.
source_title: Bir Vergi Politikası Aracı Olarak Net Servet Vergisi Uygulaması
publisher: Sosyal, Beşeri ve İdari Bilimler Dergisi
grading_note: A-grade: Public finance professor peer-reviewed research study advocating broad-based net wealth tax implementation.

design_detail: Academic study analyzing equity-efficiency tradeoffs and confirming dual potential of wealth taxation for revenue and redistribution
quote_original: Elde edilen bulgular, servet vergisinin doğru tasarlandığında hem kamu gelirlerini artırma hem de toplumsal eşitsizlikleri azaltma potansiyeline sahip olduğunu göstermektedir.
quote_en: The findings show that when properly designed, the wealth tax has the potential both to increase public revenues and to reduce social inequalities.
source_title: EŞİTSİZLİK ÇAĞINDA SERVET VERGİSİ: ETKİNLİK-ADALET DENGESİ VE ÜLKE KARŞILAŞTIRMALARI
publisher: Nevşehir Hacı Bektaş Veli Üniversitesi SBE Dergisi
grading_note: B-grade: literature study concluding that a well-designed wealth tax can raise revenue and cut inequality, with preconditions; it assesses the tax, it does not propose one for Turkey.

design_detail: Essay calling for implementation of a progressive wealth tax on capital fortunes
quote_original: Sadece beşli çetenin değil, tüm sermayenin mallarına el konulmalı ya da bir an önce kademeli servet vergisi uygulamaya sokulmalıdır.
quote_en: Not only the gang of five, but the assets of all capital should be confiscated or a progressive wealth tax should be put into effect as soon as possible.
source_title: Taşın altına elimizi koymak için ortak değerlerimiz yeterlidir – Nebiye Merttürk
grading_note: A-grade: Civil society organization leader demanding immediate progressive wealth tax on capital assets.

design_detail: Official association publication advocating progressive wealth taxation on private capital fortunes
quote_original: Sadece beşli çetenin değil, tüm sermayenin mallarına el konulmalı ya da bir an önce kademeli servet vergisi uygulamaya sokulmalıdır.
quote_en: Not only the gang of five, but the assets of all capital should be confiscated or a progressive wealth tax should be put into effect as soon as possible.
source_title: Taşın altına elimizi koymak için ortak değerlerimiz yeterlidir – Nebiye Merttürk
grading_note: A-grade: National civil society association campaign statement calling for progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: TBMM Plan and Budget Commission address asserting Turkey needs to implement a wealth tax to exit economic crisis
quote_original: Türkiye'nin bir kere bir servet vergisi uygulamaya ihtiyacı vardır, bu krizin toparlanması çok mümkün hâle gelebilir dedik
quote_en: Turkey first of all has a need to implement a wealth tax; we said that recovering from this crisis could become very possible
source_title: TBMM Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonu Tutanağı 28. Dönem 2. Devre 34. Toplantı
grading_note: A-grade: Parliamentary group leader asserting in TBMM committee that Turkey needs to implement a wealth tax.

design_detail: TBMM Plan and Budget Commission speech proposing to replace indirect taxes with wealth tax and higher corporate tax
quote_original: Bunların yerine servet vergisi getirilmeli ve kurumlar vergisi oranı yükseltilmeli.
quote_en: Instead of these, a wealth tax must be introduced and the corporate tax rate must be raised.
source_title: TBMM Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonu Tutanağı 28. Dönem 2. Devre 34. Toplantı
grading_note: A-grade: Member of Parliament proposing to introduce wealth tax to replace regressive indirect taxes in TBMM committee.

design_detail: Calls in TBMM Plan & Budget Commission for a progressive income and wealth tax system while reducing indirect taxes
quote_original: Önerilerimizi sayıyorum: Artan oranlı gelir ve servet vergisi sistemi getirilmeli, dolaylı vergiler azaltılmalı, temel ihtiyaçlardan alınan KDV kaldırılmalı, kurumlar vergisi büyük kâr eden sektörlerde artırılmalı
quote_en: I list our proposals: A progressive income and wealth tax system must be introduced, indirect taxes must be reduced, VAT on basic necessities must be abolished, and corporate tax rates on highly profitable sectors must be increased.
source_title: TBMM Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonu Tutanak Dergisi 28. Dönem 3. Yasama Yılı 3. Birleşim
grading_note: Explicit Grade A call in parliamentary committee speech for a progressive wealth tax system

design_detail: Demands expanding the scope of wealth and income taxes while gradually lowering indirect consumption taxes
quote_original: Dolaylı vergilerin payı kademeli olarak düşürülmeli, gelir ve servet vergilerinin kapsamı da genişletilmelidir. Lüks tüketim kalemlerinde hedefli bir vergilendirme, düşük gelir gruplarında da muafiyet uygulanmalıdır.
quote_en: The share of indirect taxes must be gradually lowered, and the scope of income and wealth taxes must be expanded. Targeted taxation on luxury consumption items and exemptions for low-income groups must be implemented.
source_title: TBMM Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonu Tutanak Dergisi 28. Dönem 3. Yasama Yılı 3. Birleşim
grading_note: Explicit Grade A speech in parliamentary committee by opposition İYİ Parti MP demanding expanding wealth tax scope

design_detail: Argues that unproductive idle wealth must be taxed alongside excess windfall profits to address inequality and overcome historical wealth tax taboos
quote_original: Hangi unsurun üretken sermaye, hangisinin atıl servet olduğu açık şekilde belirlenmelidir. Bu süreç tamamen hukuk çerçevesinde, ölçülebilir kriterlerle ve herkes için eşit uygulanacak biçimde yürütülmelidir. Bundan sonra ise üretken sermaye korunmalıdır. Hatta mümkün olduğunca teşvik edilmelidir. Ama atıl servet mutlaka vergilendirilmelidir.
quote_en: It must be clearly determined which element is productive capital and which is idle wealth. This process must be conducted entirely within the legal framework, with measurable criteria, and applied equally to everyone. After that, productive capital must be protected and even encouraged as much as possible. But idle wealth must definitely be taxed.
source_title: Servetten vergi alınmalı ve “aşırı kâr vergisi” getirilmelidir
grading_note: Explicit Grade A op-ed article arguing that idle wealth must be taxed

design_detail: Joint healthcare trade union campaign demanding a wealth tax on the rich and capping employee income tax at 15%
quote_original: Çalışanlardan alınan gelir vergisi oranını en fazla yüzde 15’te sabitleyin, zenginlere servet vergisi getirin.
quote_en: Cap the income tax rate taken from employees at a maximum of 15%, introduce a wealth tax on the rich.
